faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Medicore works online: all you need is internet and a browser on your computer.

items.q: Do I need to be good with technology?
items.a: Not at all. It’s designed so anyone on your team can use it from day one, and we help you set it up.

items.q: Which plan is right for me?
items.a: If you work alone, Independent professional. For several doctors, Clinic or Clinic Plus depending on how many you are. For larger centers or several locations, Enterprise. We’ll help you choose in the demo.

items.q: Who counts as a doctor on my plan?
items.a: Any professional who sees patients: doctors, dentists, psychologists, nutritionists… Quotas are based on active users: if someone leaves the clinic, you deactivate their user and free up the spot.
Modules you can add to any plan: vaccination, medication administration and minor procedures. Get them separately or all three as a bundle; prices are in the plans section.
Yes. When your practice grows, just write to us and we’ll move you to the plan you need.

items.q: Is there a limit on patients or visits?
items.a: No. On every plan you can record as many patients, visits, prescriptions and records as you need.

items.q: What happens to my records if I change plans?
items.a: They stay put. Changing plans doesn’t delete or lock your patients’ information.
